note: Routing corpus of record (minted 2026-07-17, when feature converted from command to procedural species so it and its two siblings — issue, file-bug — can invoke each other directly on a mis-routed ask instead of just pointing the user at a command). Positives: natural capability-proposal phrasings plus id-resume syntax, plus (t07) the knowledge-shape claim the description makes but the original suite never tested, per a fresh-context review. t03 was swapped from an ambiguous 'I want a calculator with a tarzan theme' (plausibly a /build-feature ask, not an intake ask) to an unambiguous proposal phrasing. Negatives drawn adversarially from the two siblings (bug-shaped and chore-shaped asks must NOT trigger feature), check-doc, make-doc (authoring a doc directly rather than intake), find-intent, and a build request (feature never builds). Open finding (2026-07-19, a full docs /check-routing alongside the knowledge-forge retirement, kimgranlund/claude-plugins#58): t07 ('this feature request is really asking us to document our color contrast standards as a reference corpus') was blind-judge-grabbed by make-reference instead of feature. Reconfirmed 3-of-3 by the 2026-08-20 post-rename scoped re-judge (kimgranlund/claude-plugins#802 follow-up), seam predates that rename — tracked and TUNED under kimgranlund/claude-plugins#804: file-feature's description now leads with the knowledge-shape claim explicitly ("routes HERE FIRST... hands off to make-reference") and make-reference's own description carries a reciprocal NOT-for-intake fence (see its n14). t07's prompt text is left unchanged deliberately — the fix is proven against the same flagship phrasing that stole it, not by re-keying the case to something easier. A post-tune scoped blind re-judge (docs plugin menu, harness:routing-judge, shuffled/expect-stripped, 2-of-3 on contested cases) is the acceptance bar for this tune; see #804's PR for the tally.
